title: A project member can download another tenant's invoices
summary: A signed-in member who knows an invoice number can read another tenant's billing details.
rootCause: The invoice lookup filters by identifier but does not constrain the owning tenant.

steps: Sign in as a project member.
Request an invoice identifier belonging to another tenant.

severity.rationale: Billing records cross a tenant boundary without permission, exposing customer details.

confidence.rationale: The lookup and response are visible in source.

codeEvidence.label: Unscoped lookup
codeEvidence.explanation: The caller's tenant is not part of the query.

counterEvidence: A gateway might enforce ownership before routing the request.
proofGaps: Production gateway policy was not available.

validation.summary: Inspected the route, query, and session check; no runtime request was sent.

remediation.summary: Bind the invoice query to the authenticated tenant and deny unmatched records.
regressionTests: A member requesting another tenant's invoice receives a denial.
